title: Our family of five (with...
text:
Our family of five (with three kids 20, 18, 14) all enjoyed this tour. We got to try some local tapas. Our guide was very knowledgeable and we learned a lot. 

We had a small hiccup — one of the restaurants wasn’t open when we arrived. But the tour operator quickly found a replacement.
author: Laurel_R

title: Highlight of my trip to Seville
text: The bars were full of locals, we were able to enjoy traditional food and dive into history, as if we were authentic Sevillians. When we come back we will repeat
author: C746SRjamest

title: Amazing!!
text: Absolutely loved this tour! Great food, great company, and a fantastic way to dive into Andalusian culture. We left with full stomachs and a list of spots to return to!!
author: xlucygl
